messages:
jess (CS): quick capture from DeltaRetail onboarding call — they surfaced 6 product asks, a couple are renewal-risking. dropping raw notes here so we can triage and hand off.

maya (AE): paste the items pls

jess (CS): 1) Feature request: per-route cost attribution (need invoice-level split by route/model + daily trend). impact: renewal.
2) Pain: onboarding console lacks token burn time-series per deployment — hard to forecast overages.
3) Request: ability to pin model version per-route (they saw output drift after auto-upgrade).
4) Ask: SSO + exportable audit logs for security review.
5) UX: clearer state/notice when Dedicated capacity is near exhaustion (they saw intermittent 503s; thought it was their network).
6) Enablement: short 30-min session on caching/quantization best practices for their infra team.

omar (PM): thanks. prelim prioritization from product lens: per-route cost attribution = P0 (renewal risk), token time-series dashboard = P1, model-pin per-route = P1, capacity UX = P1, SSO/audit logs = P2, enablement session = P2.

sam (ProdOps): Agree on P0 for per-route billing. Quick asks: can we get repro artifacts and a sample invoice? Also we should standardize a capture template so AEs submit structured data next time.

maya (AE): I'll ask DeltaRetail for invoice sample + screenshots.

jess (CS): suggested short capture template for AE -> product intake:
```
customer_id,ask_type,impact_category,frequency,repro_steps,attachments,contact_owner
delta-retail,feature,renewal_risk,daily,"embedding jobs >10k tokens stall on dedicated pool","delta-invoice-2026-03.png,console-logs.txt",maya
```

feedback-bot: New NPS submission from delta-retail: 6/10 — comment: "costs unpredictable; need per-route billing visibility"

maria (PMM): Can we route the P0 item to billing-improvements board and tag it renewal-risk? Also would be good to include a short customer quote in the ticket.

omar (PM): will create the ticket in product board, tag it billing-improvements + renewal-risk, link to this thread and the invoice when Maya provides it. assigning initial triage to @eng-billing and @observability.

maya (AE): added — I'll upload invoice + screenshot once I get it from their finance team this afternoon.

jess (CS): action items:
- Maya: collect invoice + screenshots (today)
- Omar: create product ticket, set priority P0 for per-route cost attribution (ETA: include a quick spec)
- Sam: draft short intake template we can push to AEs as a capture form (I'll prototype a Google Sheet)
- Product: confirm owners for P1 items after ticket creation

jess (CS): thanks team — keeping an eye on this since renewal convo scheduled in two weeks. will ping if Delta escalates. :eyes:
